caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object composed of two vertical curved arms that form an arch at the top, with their lower ends separated and aligned parallel to each other. These arms appear to be made from a light brown wood with visible grain patterns. A cylindrical horizontal shaft passes through both of the vertical arms near the bottom; this shaft also appears to be crafted from the same wood. On the left side of the shaft, there is a large, round wooden knob, ridged along its circumference, suggesting it can be gripped and turned. On the right side, the end of the shaft is capped by a flared, petal-like wooden fixture. The background is a plain, light tan color, and the object itself is centered in the composition with no additional items or decorative elements.
title: Wooden Cleavis
